decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a variety of specialized bags including foldable daypacks, hydration rucksacks, cooler backpacks, and dry bags. I narrowed my consideration set to the five products with the strongest ratings and most relevant utility for outdoor use. I chose the MOSISO Sling Backpack (prod_backpacks_089) as the final selection because it offers a highly-rated, compact design for short hikes and daily use at an affordable price point, with strong social proof from over 1,200 positive reviews.
